title: Synthetic privileged group change
objective: Detect an unexpected administrative group membership change and produce an evidence-preserving simulated response.
authorization_boundary: Synthetic audit records only. No identity provider or host is modified.
expected_outcome: One critical detection associated with the unauthorized group-change event.

rules.name: Unexpected privileged group membership change
rules.description: A non-approved actor adds an account to a privileged group without a change ticket.

response.description: Recommend reviewing the synthetic actor and target accounts, preserving the audit record, and confirming change authorization.
